Thank you for your patience!  The "Uni's pin badge" that has been requested since last year will be available for purchase on Tuesday, April 30th, at 10:00 PM Japan time.  As each pin badge is handmade by us, quantities are limited. We have prepared three different designs, so please find your favorite.  Once again, we will be collaborating with "Japanese Creative Bookstore" to offer sticker sets. Each set includes one hologram sticker and four die-cut stickers, totaling five stickers.  【Uni’s pin badge (face ver.) & sticker set】  【Uni’s pin badge (cardboard-box ver.) & sticker set】  【Uni’s pin badge (egg uni ver.) & sticker set】  Furthermore, due to popular demand from last year, we will be selling a small quantity of postcard books as a set. Each postcard book contains 20 postcards.  【 Uni’s pin badge (face ver.) & Postcard Book & sticker set 】  【 Uni’s pin badge (cardboard-box ver.) & Postcard Book & sticker set 】  【 Uni’s pin badge (egg uni ver.) & Postcard Book & sticker set 】  Additionally, the 2024 Minuet Uni Wall Calendar, which sold out at the end of last year, will be available for purchase again. This will also be sold as a set with stickers.  【 2024 Minuet Uni Wall Calendar & sticker set 】  Please note: - These items are available for sale to international customers only. - The postcard books and stickers are a collaboration with "Japanese Creative Bookstore（ @japanese.creative.bookstore ）" and can only be purchased at their shop.
